blocks.text: Hum roz dekhte hain ke oopar phenki gayi cheez kuch oonchai tak ja kar wapas zameen par aa jati hai. Yeh neeche ki taraf lagne wali gravity ki force ki wajah se hai. Initial (shuru ki) velocity zyada ho to cheez zyada oonchai tak ja kar wapas aati hai. Agar initial velocity barhate jayein to aik waqt aata hai jab cheez wapas nahi aati; woh gravity ke asar se nikal (escape) jati hai.

blocks.title: Escape velocity
blocks.text: Cheez ki woh initial velocity jis se woh Zameen ki gravitational field se bahar nikal jaye, escape velocity kehlati hai.

blocks.caption: For Your Information: Kuch escape speeds (km s⁻¹)

blocks.text: Escape velocity se jism ko itni initial kinetic energy milti hai jo usay Zameen ki satah se infinity tak le jaye.
Hum jante hain ke jism ko Zameen ki satah se infinity tak uthane ka work potential energy ke izafe (increase) ke barabar hai (topic 4.5 se satah par P.E. = −GMm/R aur infinity par zero):

blocks.text_alt: P.E. mein izafa = 0 − (−G Mm/R) = G Mm/R

blocks.text: jahan M aur R Zameen ka mass aur radius hain. Jism gravitational field se tab nikal jayega jab us ki initial K.E. P.E. ke izafe ke barabar ho:

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Dono taraf m hai, is liye kat jata hai. Matlab escape velocity jism ke mass par depend nahi karti: 1 kg ka patthar ho ya 1000 kg ka rocket, dono ke liye 11.2 km s⁻¹.

blocks.text_alt: Kyun ke   g = GM/R²   or   gR = GM/R

blocks.text: v_esc ki qeemat taqreeban 11 km s⁻¹ aati hai (√(2 × 9.8 m s⁻² × 6.4 × 10⁶ m) ≈ 1.12 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹).

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: Kitab ki equation mein “Incerase” chhapa hai; yeh sirf spelling ki ghalti hai (sahi: Increase). Equation khud theek hai.

blocks.prompt: Dikhayein ke escape velocity √(2gR) likhi ja sakti hai aur Zameen ke liye us ki qeemat nikalein (comprehensive question 4.6). Yeh 1 kg ke patthar aur 1000 kg ke rocket ke liye ek jaisi kyun hai?
blocks.explanation: Initial K.E. ko infinity tak P.E. ke izafe ke barabar rakhein: ½ mv² = GMm/R, to v = √(2GM/R). g = GM/R² se GM/R = gR, to v = √(2gR) = √(2 × 9.8 × 6.4 × 10⁶) = 1.12 × 10⁴ m s⁻¹, taqreeban 11 km s⁻¹. Mass m dono taraf kat jata hai, is liye escape velocity sirf sayyare (planet) ke g aur R par depend karti hai, jism ke mass par nahi.

items: Escape velocity: woh initial velocity jo jism ko Zameen ki gravitational field se nikal de.
½ m v_esc² = GMm/R se v_esc = √(2GM/R) = √(2gR) ≈ 11 km s⁻¹ (Zameen 11.2; Chand 2.4; Jupiter 61 km s⁻¹).
